newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rises, aided by low output, UK budget.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rises, aided by low output, UK budget.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices rose on Friday, helped by low refinery production and buying in the paper market ahead of the U.K. government's November 26 budget, traders said.
Regular unleaded barges were heard done twice at $226.50 fob ARA and premium unleaded at $234.50, $236 and $236.50.
Premium unleaded was seen tighter on refinery turnarounds and as strong gas oil discourages gasoline output, they said.
But one trader said there was plenty of low octane in northwest Europe with no buyers, which may hurt those grades.
